ignorePatterns.comment: Local MinIO consoles from the docker-compose dev stack, not reachable from CI
RFC 2606 reserved domains used as placeholders in generated resource docs
Placeholder etcd endpoints; the comma-separated example parses as an invalid URL and crashes the checker
Changelog compare links reference the release tag before it exists; the tag lands minutes later in the same release flow
Contact addresses in the code of conduct. The checker resolves mailto: links against DNS, so an unrelated lookup failure fails an unchanged file on an unrelated pull request

Links to this repository's own issues and pull requests, mostly in CHANGELOG.md. The checker makes one request per number and github.com answers some of them with status 0 or 502 from CI runners, so a pull request fails on links it did not touch. The numbers are written by maintainers and already exist
The Codecov app is a JavaScript page that does not answer the checker from CI runners (status 0), so the badge link in the README fails every pull request whatever it changes
